-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.InvConfChangeMsg` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem ccEntsOk_normal (ents : List EntryM) (H : ∀ (e : EntryM), e ∈ ents → e.Type' = W32 0) : ⊢
    ccEntsOk ents (List.map (fun x => none) ents)

theorem ccEntsOk_leaveOk (ents : List EntryM) (cs : List (Option ConfChangeIM)) : ccEntsOk ents cs ⊢
    ⌜CCLeaveOk ents cs⌝

theorem ccEntsOk_types (ents : List EntryM) (cs : List (Option ConfChangeIM)) : ccEntsOk ents cs ⊢
    ⌜CCTypesOk ents cs⌝

theorem ccEntOk_persistent (e : EntryM) (o : Option ConfChangeIM) : Persistent (ccEntOk e o)

theorem ccEntOk_type (e : EntryM) (o : Option ConfChangeIM) : ccEntOk e o ⊢ ⌜o.isSome = decide
    (IsConfEnt e)⌝

def ccEntOk (e : EntryM) : Option ConfChangeIM → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => iprop(⌜¬IsConfEnt e⌝)
  | some (ConfChangeIM.v1 m) => iprop(⌜e.Type' = W32 1 ∧ ccDecodeV1 e.Data' = some m⌝)
  | some (ConfChangeIM.v2 m) => iprop(⌜e.Type' = W32 2 ∧ ccDecodeV2 e.Data' = some m⌝)

def ccEntsOk (ents : List EntryM) (cs : List (Option ConfChangeIM)) : IProp GF :=
  [∗list] e;o ∈ ents;cs, ccEntOk e o

theorem ccEntsOk_persistent (ents : List EntryM) (cs : List (Option ConfChangeIM)) : Persistent
    (ccEntsOk ents cs)
